assertions.text: legalTools(run, items, questions, repoConfigured) -> {legal: Map<toolName, argsHint>, recommended: {tool,args}|null, why}; single source for gate + injection + continuation
conductor_status legal in EVERY state including terminal
conductor_decide/surface/defer legal in every non-terminal state; conductor_answer legal whenever an open question exists, terminal runs included
UNCLASSIFIED INTAKE => only conductor_classify; INTAKE with classification work => conductor_decompose recommended
PLAN_REVIEWED => conductor_dispatch_wave recommended (performs PLAN_REVIEWED->EXECUTING on first call)
a two-item wave yields a legal SET containing both items' next tools and exactly ONE recommended, deterministic under item reordering
EXECUTING with I1 at TEST_VETTED => conductor_mark_green{I1} legal, conductor_publish{I1} illegal
a blocked item contributes NO tools to the legal set
non-behavioral PENDING item offers conductor_mark_green, not conductor_submit_test
EXECUTING flagged trivial legalizes the item tools and conductor_report
repoConfigured false => ONLY conductor_setup and conductor_status
isTerminal run => status (+ answer when questions open) and nothing else
